scope: Hoth first, ten stock SWG destinations, all catalogue planets with local terrain evidence, then three orientation worlds
source_policy: Wookieepedia Legends preferred; Jakku explicit canon exception; text is original paraphrase, no images imported
mapping: Grid centers are approximate atlas-square centres, not physical XYZ or client pixels. Shared-system destinations are duplicate anchors.
remaining_gaps: Complete sector/moon inventories where null or pending
Pixel fit against actual stock UI with residuals; no numeric client pixel placement claimed

planets.name: Hoth
planets.climate_and_terrain: Frozen ice plains, glaciers and mountains
planets.species_and_creatures: Wampas; tauntauns
planets.notable_places: Echo Base; wampa caves; Clabburn Range
planets.summary: Hoth is a remote frozen world with dangerous wildlife. The Rebels built Echo Base in its caves, then lost it during the Imperial attack in 3 ABY. A local expedition can focus on shelter, supply routes and predator encounters without assuming our snapshot already contains the famous base.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Corellia
planets.moons: Gus Talon and Gus Treta (system source)
planets.climate_and_terrain: Temperate; farms, towns and coasts
planets.species_and_creatures: Humans, Drall and Selonians (residents; origins differ)
planets.summary: Corellia is a major inhabited world of the Corellian system. Its communities include Humans, Drall and Selonians, with many inhabitants living outside the capital. Coronet and its surrounding economy suit shipping, investigation and civilian supply stories.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Dantooine
planets.climate_and_terrain: Grasslands, rivers, lakes and blba trees
planets.species_and_creatures: Dantari; kath hounds; kinrath; graul
planets.notable_places: Ruined Jedi Enclave; former Rebel base
planets.summary: Dantooine is a lightly developed agricultural world away from heavy galactic traffic. Native Dantari share it with settlers and varied wildlife. Ancient structures and abandoned military sites support exploration, but Old Republic story events must not be treated as current happenings.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Dathomir
planets.climate_and_terrain: Mountain/river terrain documented at Singing Mountain; broader climate pending
planets.species_and_creatures: Dathomiri Witches; rancors; gaping spiders; malklocs
planets.notable_places: Singing Mountain Clan settlement; Singing Mountain
planets.summary: Dathomir is a remote world associated with witch clans and rancors. Singing Mountain is an important place for its namesake clan. Clan relationships and dangerous wilderness offer grounded SWG objectives without importing later canon-only landscapes wholesale.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Endor
planets.moons: Playable destination is the forest moon of gas giant Endor; giant has 9 moons
planets.climate_and_terrain: Temperate forests, mountains, lakes and savannas
planets.species_and_creatures: Ewoks; Duloks; introduced fauna varies by era
planets.summary: SWG Endor is the forest moon rather than its parent gas giant. It has a broad ecosystem and a history shaped partly by crashed ships. Wilderness and settlement content fit it, while Death Star-era installations need a deliberate timeline check.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Lok
planets.climate_and_terrain: Arid deserts, jagged ranges, sulfur pools and lava pits
planets.species_and_creatures: Kimogila; mixed settler/pirate population
planets.summary: Lok is a harsh world associated with pirates and Nym. Its dangerous terrain and wildlife make travel outside the stronghold consequential. Salvage, contraband and faction-pressure stories fit its established character.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Naboo
planets.climate_and_terrain: Temperate plains, hills, swamps, mountains and seas
planets.species_and_creatures: Gungans; Human Naboo colonists
planets.notable_places: Lake Paonga; Lianorm Swamp; Emperor's Retreat
planets.summary: Naboo combines extensive natural landscapes with distinctive settled societies. Its native Gungans and Human population have separate histories and communities. Civilian diplomacy and Imperial-era local tensions can coexist without assuming every famous Clone Wars event is occurring now.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Rori
planets.moons: Rori is a moon of Naboo; submoons not verified
planets.climate_and_terrain: Swamps, hills, forests and grasslands under gray skies
planets.species_and_creatures: Bark mites; tortons; borgle bats; Gungan outposts
planets.summary: Rori is one of Naboo's three moons. Its overgrown terrain makes settlement and travel difficult. Narmle and Restuss are established locations, but their exact state must follow the server's chosen era rather than an assumed later-game event.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Talus
planets.moons: Several (names not verified); Tralus is a paired planet, not a moon
planets.climate_and_terrain: Temperate forests, grass plains and mudflats
planets.species_and_creatures: Humans, Drall, Selonians; Zabrak colony
planets.notable_places: Dearic; Nashal; Centerpoint in the system
planets.summary: Talus and Tralus form the Double Worlds around a shared centre of gravity. Talus has farming, mining and manufacturing communities. Its federal institutions and Imperial scrutiny support civic and industrial stories distinct from Corellia's capital.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Tatooine
planets.climate_and_terrain: Desert; dry settlements and moisture farms
planets.species_and_creatures: Jawas; Tusken Raiders; mixed offworld population
planets.notable_places: Mos Eisley; Jabba's Palace; Jundland Wastes
planets.summary: Tatooine is a remote desert world in a binary-star system. Moisture farming and equipment trading sustain many residents. Criminal power and scattered settlements make local survival and transport suitable themes.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Yavin 4
planets.moons: Moon of Yavin Prime; submoon counts conflict (0/1/2 in article)
planets.climate_and_terrain: Tropical jungle, low-relief continents, mountains and volcanoes
planets.species_and_creatures: Massassi heritage; present living native species not established here
planets.summary: Yavin 4 is a large habitable moon of Yavin Prime. Its jungles conceal structures linked to ancient Sith history and the Rebel base. Exploration should separate those historical layers and avoid placing later Jedi-academy events into an earlier SWG era.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Taanab
planets.climate_and_terrain: Mild fields, waterways and intensive agriculture
planets.species_and_creatures: Imported roba, staga, nerfs and banthas; no original animal fauna per article
planets.summary: Taanab is an agricultural world on useful trade routes. Its commercial farms and imported animals distinguish it from untouched wilderness. Pirate raids and cargo protection are suitable local stories; do not label imported farm animals indigenous.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Dromund Kaas
planets.climate_and_terrain: Sea, swamp and jungle
planets.species_and_creatures: Local monsters not individually verified in this pass
planets.notable_places: Dark Force Temple; historical Kaas City
planets.summary: Dromund Kaas has a long Sith history and extensive swamps. Its Old Republic capital and later forgotten temples belong to different periods. A Galactic Civil War expedition should not simply reproduce the populated SWTOR capital.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Mandalore
planets.climate_and_terrain: Northern forests with cold winters; regional variety
planets.species_and_creatures: Mandalorian residents; shatuals; strills
planets.summary: Mandalore is the cultural homeworld of the Mandalorians. Legends describes northern forests and Keldabe alongside other regional environments. Mining, clan relationships and Imperial pressure suit this period without reducing the entire world to one later television depiction.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Chandrila
planets.climate_and_terrain: Temperate forests, hills, plains and seas
planets.species_and_creatures: Residents/species not individually verified here
planets.notable_places: Hanna City; Crystal Canyons; Silver Sea
planets.summary: Chandrila is a temperate Core World. Its towns, natural parks and cultural sites offer a less militarized setting than a battlefield planet. Local antiquities, civic and supply stories can use these places without assuming later New Republic institutions already exist.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Coruscant
planets.moons: Centax-1, Centax-2, Centax-3; Hesperidium listed as fourth
planets.climate_and_terrain: Urban world; detailed climate not verified in extract
planets.species_and_creatures: Cosmopolitan residents; individual native fauna pending
planets.summary: Coruscant occupies a central political and economic position in galactic history. Its location is also the conventional origin for one coordinate system. Any local urban district needs a defined Imperial-era identity rather than a blend of unrelated historical capitals.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Jakku
planets.climate_and_terrain: Arid badlands, dunes and salt flats
planets.species_and_creatures: Teedo; Uthuthma; diverse settlers
planets.notable_places: Desert settlements; Niima Outpost and graveyard are later-period examples only
planets.summary: Jakku is a canon world with a desert landscape. Its famous wreck fields and Niima Outpost arose after the Battle of Jakku. A pre-CU-era adaptation must be labelled an optional continuity addition and must not transplant that later aftermath without a deliberate alternate-history choice.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Korriban (MTG zone moraband)
planets.climate_and_terrain: Dry tomb world; detailed climate pending
planets.species_and_creatures: Sith species historically; living population depends on era
planets.summary: Korriban is an ancient sacred world of the Sith. Its burial sites and dark-side history make it a place for carefully bounded exploration. The MTG zone name moraband is a runtime alias, not permission to blend all canon and Legends events.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Nal Hutta
planets.moons: Nar Shaddaa confirmed; complete moon inventory pending
planets.climate_and_terrain: Swamp environment; detailed climate pending
planets.species_and_creatures: Evocii native; Hutts and t'landa Til are arrivals
planets.notable_places: Bilbousa; Jiguuna; Nar Shaddaa in orbit
planets.summary: Nal Hutta was once called Evocar. The Hutts displaced the native Evocii and made it a centre of their power. Local stories should reflect clan control and that history, rather than describing Hutts as the original native species.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Kashyyyk
planets.climate_and_terrain: Forested world; full climate detail pending
planets.species_and_creatures: Wookiees; other wildlife pending specific article checks
planets.notable_places: Forest communities; Avatar Orbital Platform in system
planets.summary: Kashyyyk is the Wookiee homeworld. Its system also contains Trandosha and several inhabited moons. A bounded forest settlement or rescue story is feasible separately from a complete port of the later SWG expansion campaign.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Mustafar
planets.climate_and_terrain: Volcanic lava rivers, ash and obsidian mountains
planets.species_and_creatures: Northern/Southern Mustafarians; lava fleas; blistmoks; jundaks
planets.summary: Mustafar is a volcanically unstable mining world. Native Mustafarians adapted their work and settlements to its severe conditions. Original mining and rescue objectives can use that setting without implying the complete Trials of Obi-Wan campaign has been backported.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Dagobah
planets.climate_and_terrain: Humid swamps, marshes and dense forests
planets.species_and_creatures: Hepsalum Tash; bogwings; dragonsnakes; nudj
planets.summary: Dagobah is a remote swamp world with abundant life and little settlement. It sheltered Yoda after Order 66. Exploration can emphasize navigation and ecology without making access to its hidden resident routine.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Bespin
planets.climate_and_terrain: Gas giant; narrow habitable atmospheric layer
planets.species_and_creatures: Humans/Ugnaught residents; airborne algae
planets.summary: Bespin is a gas giant with a habitable atmospheric band. Cloud City occupies that band rather than a solid planetary surface. A port therefore needs convincing platform boundaries and travel rules, not merely a conventional walkable ground terrain.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.

planets.name: Alderaan
planets.moons: One historical moon; destruction chronology requires checking
planets.climate_and_terrain: Destroyed in normal post-Yavin timeline; pre-destruction terrain not catalogued here
planets.species_and_creatures: Native species not verified in this pass
planets.summary: Alderaan was destroyed by the first Death Star before the Battle of Yavin. Its former orbit became the Graveyard asteroid field. A living ground-world destination conflicts with an ordinary post-Yavin SWG timeline and would need an explicit flashback or alternate setting.
planets.verification: Wookieepedia search-index excerpts; direct pages restricted. Unknown/pending fields are not inferred.
